payload.summary: Railway has no Australian region, so the current app tier cannot host a real-patient Caring Contacts deployment
payload.detail: docs/deployment-architecture.md records Railway regions as US West, US East, Amsterdam and Singapore; the app tier runs in Singapore against Supabase in ap-southeast-2 Sydney. The Caring Contacts decision lock requires identifiers, message content, application data, backups, logs and provider processing to remain in Australia. A real-patient pilot therefore needs a separately contracted Australian PHI-capable environment, not the current Clinical KB deployment. Does not block the synthetic build, which holds no real patient data. Hazard H-36.
payload.source: docs/deployment-architecture.md; Caring Contacts decision lock hosting controls
